source.title: Open problems on Sombor index of unicyclic and bicyclic graphs.

needs_review.question_text_raw: In the same paper, they mentioned that the maximal graphs over the set of unicyclic and bicyclic graphs with respect to Sombor index is an interesting problem that remains open. In this paper we completely solve these problems.
